summary: SPAC byNordic Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting a monthly extension of its business combination deadline from June 12 to July 12, 2026, funded by a $17,470 deposit into the trust account. This is a routine mechanical extension previously authorized by shareholders on August 6, 2025, allowing up to twelve additional months through August 12, 2026. No target, price, or premium terms are involved. The board approved the deposit in advance. The trust is collateral for the SPAC structure; actual share redemptions absent a deal. Watch for whether a definitive merger agreement is announced before the July 12 deadline, else risk liquidation.
